title: Most Vowels in a Window
statement:
Given a string `text` of lowercase letters and a length `k`, look at every stretch of exactly `k` consecutive letters.

Return the **largest number of vowels** (`a`, `e`, `i`, `o`, `u`) that any such stretch contains.
constraints: text contains only lowercase letters a-z

examples.explanation: The stretch iii has three vowels.
For example eet or ode contain two vowels.

hints.nudge: When the stretch moves one letter to the right, which two letters change?
hints.pattern: Sliding window with a running count of vowels.
hints.pseudocode:
count = vowels in the first k letters; best = count
for i from k to n-1:
  if text[i] is a vowel: count++
  if text[i-k] is a vowel: count--
  best = max(best, count)
hints.walkthrough: Counting vowels in every stretch from scratch costs O(n*k). Keep the vowel count of the current window. When you slide right by one letter, add one if the new letter is a vowel and subtract one if the letter that dropped out was a vowel. Track the maximum. O(n) time.
